merchant/31963.htm.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: Nice to meet you! I'm Mineral Trader Hitchi. I'm not bragging, but our family has operated a mineral trading business for 4 generations. When the train was still working, people came from the ends of Aden to buy from us. Business is a little slower now, but the quality of our…

links.text: View information about the local lord and tax rate.

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-01.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: Is this the test of the Artisan? Then you definitely have something to tell me! Huh, then the final execution day is...! Well, what is it? Please tell me!

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-04.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: Thank you for telling me the story. Now go to Lockirin in Dwarven Village at the Iron Gate Guild. He'll tell you what you need to do next. Ha!

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-06a.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitch: Please give this message to Railroad Worker Obi. Registration complete. Will wait for execution date. That's it.

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-08.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: Please deliver this to Warehouse Keeper Rydel in the Town of Schuttgart. Good news arrived that you've been waiting for. Give messenger appropriate reward.

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-11.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: Just a minute, what's the hurry? Come on, please wait here with me for a while. Wouldn't you like to be an Artisan? Don't get me wrong... I just want to know what you think about our six Dwarven guilds.

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-02.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: The golden wagon wheels shake..! By the way, do you have any idea what you just said?

links.text: "I don't think. Thinking is someone else's job."
"I did think about it and decided to say something."

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-03.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: Ha! Awesome! Just like a craftsman, eh? Thanks for telling me that story. Now you should go talk to Lockirin in Dwarven Village at the Iron Gate Guild. He'll tell you what you need to do next. Ha!

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-05.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: Is that so? Well, that has nothing to do with me, anyway! Please go and speak with the Railroad Worker Obi and deliver this: Registration complete. Will wait for execution date.

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-06.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: Do you need something else?

links.text: "No, not at all. I'll deliver the message."
"I don't want to get involved in this! I'm leaving."

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-07.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: Is that so? Oh, it's not that bad! Please deliver this to Warehouse Keeper Rydel in the Town of Schuttgart. Good news arrived that you've been waiting for. Give messenger appropriate reward.

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-09.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: Just a minute, what's the hurry? Come on, why don't you wait here for a while? Wouldn't you like to be an Artisan? Don't get me wrong... I just wanted to find out what you thought about our six Dwarven guilds.

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/31963-10.html.text: Mineral Trader Hitchi: I think Obi probably told me this story... The six Dwarven Guilds are like the columns that support the house of Dwarves.
